description: Use when Cursor subagents run on the parent model instead of the model in their agent file, or the user asks: "use claude code subagents", "run scout on haiku", "why are my subagents all Opus?". Runs custom subagents through headless Claude Code. Skip for Cursor's built-in subagents or Cloud Agents.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
